title: The Andes and the Amazon; Or, Across the Continent of South America

author: James Orton
description: "The Andes and the Amazon: Or, Across the Continent of South America" by James Orton is a travel narrative and scientific account written in the late 19th century.
longDescription: This volume emerges from an expedition to the equatorial Andes and the Amazon River, aimed at exploring and documenting the geography, natural history, and cultures of South America.

authorInfo.bio: James Orton (1830–1877) wrote The Andes and the Amazon; Or, Across the Continent of South America. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
